name: interviewhub
description: InterviewHub – Real-Time Interview & Collaboration Platform (MERN + Socket.IO)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: node init && npm run build --prefix client
